question: Explain how refraction through a prism leads to dispersion of white light. Give reason why different colours emerge in different directions.

options.A: White light splits because all colours have the same refractive index in glass and therefore deviate equally.
options.B: A prism separates colours only through reflection at its faces; refraction has no role.
options.C: Red deviates more than violet because red has a greater refractive index in glass.
options.D: White light is refracted at both prism faces. Since the refractive index of glass differs for different colours, they deviate by different amounts; violet deviates more and red deviates less, so they emerge in different directions.
